comment: Seed golden set — 12 judged queries over fixtures/retrieval_corpus. SEED means exactly that: enough to catch a regression in the two failure classes witnessed in the field (rare-term burial in a long note; question-echo decoys outranking the answer) plus direct and paraphrase baselines. It is not a quality benchmark of the vault, and scores are only comparable within one embedder model — the runner prints which one produced them. Expand toward ~50 with real misses as the field log collects them; KNOWN_LIMITATIONS entry 12 is the context.

tiers.direct: query shares distinctive words with the relevant passage
tiers.paraphrase: no distinctive word overlap; semantic leg must carry it
tiers.burial: the answer's rare term sits inside a long note; short decoys echo the question
tiers.decoy: a page exists that echoes the question's phrasing and answers nothing

queries.q: how many days do customers have to return a purchase
when does the Dubai office open
what do new hires receive on day one
can I send back something I bought two weeks ago
getting into prod as a fresh employee
booking economy versus business for short trips
